feature1.prompt: The 'autodoc_type_aliases' functionality does not work when 'autodoc_typehints' is set to 'description'. Currently, when generating documentation for functions such as those in types.py, the output shows the default type (e.g., Dict[str, Any]) instead of the expected alias (e.g., types.JSONObject). This behavior is inconsistent because the configuration for type aliases is not being taken into account during signature inspection. The fix should update the core functionality so that the type alias specified in the configuration is always correctly applied in the generated documentation.
feature1.hint_texts: This feature requires modifying the record_typehints function in sphinx/ext/autodoc/typehints.py. The implementation should change the call to inspect.signature to include the type_aliases parameter using the value from app.config.autodoc_type_aliases. Developers should ensure that existing functionality remains intact and that the modified function continues to work with all scenarios that were previously supported.
feature1.entrypoint: File: sphinx/ext/autodoc/typehints.py; Function: record_typehints. Look for the code block where inspect.signature(obj) is called and update it to inspect.signature(obj, type_aliases=app.config.autodoc_type_aliases).

feature2.prompt: It is necessary to verify that the configured type aliases are correctly applied when 'autodoc_typehints' is set to 'description'. The expected outcome is that the documentation should display the alias (for example, types.JSONObject) rather than the default type, even when the description mode is enabled. This feature focuses on validating that the integration of type alias configuration works properly and that the signature output reflects the alias settings. Ensuring this behavior will resolve the discrepancy observed in the output.
feature2.hint_texts: This feature involves adding a new test case to check the correct application of type aliases with the 'description' setting. Developers should create a dedicated test in the tests directory that sets up the configuration with autodoc_typehints as 'description' and provides a sample type alias. The test must build the documentation and assert that the rendered output contains the alias in the function signatures.
feature2.entrypoint: File: tests/test_ext_autodoc_configs.py; Test Function: test_autodoc_typehints_description_and_type_aliases. Add the new test case so that it builds the documentation with the specified configuration and checks the documentation output for correct type alias substitution.

collaboration_points.shared_resources: Both features rely on the Sphinx configuration, especially the app.config.autodoc_type_aliases setting, and the overall signature generation logic in autodoc. The file sphinx/ext/autodoc/typehints.py and related documentation build infrastructure are common resources.
collaboration_points.integration_strategy: Feature1 implements the underlying functionality by modifying the record_typehints routine, while Feature2 ensures that this functionality is properly verified through an integration test. The interface exposed by Feature1 must be fully compatible with the test scenario defined in Feature2 for successful documentation generation.
